title_yt: Is a fake sick day for GTA 6 really free? #Shorts
title_fb: Is a fake sick day for GTA 6 really free?
hook: If you fake sick for G T A six, what do you pay?
open_loop: Hook asks what the sick day costs. Boss believes Benny (small win), he plays all day for nothing, and the price ($247 = more than three games) lands only in lines 4-5; line 6 closes the 'free' loop.
payoff: Pay stub -$247 = more than three generic $79.99 boxes for one day. Playing after work is the really free option.

lines.text: If you fake sick for G T A 6, what do you pay?
lines.say: If you fake sick for G T A six, what do you pay?
lines.visual: SCENE 1: Benny in office shirt and tie at desk, phone to ear, fist-cough. Hooded stranger (boss) behind him, arms crossed, squinting suspiciously. Headline 'GTA 6 SICK DAY' (headline may use written form). SCENE 2 (on 'cost'): snap-zoom, big gold '$?' stamp slams in over the desk.

lines.text: Your boss believes you. You are free!
lines.visual: SCENE 3: Boss shrugs 'okay', Benny throws the tie, hoodie on, arms up, happy. Small confetti.

lines.text: Now you play all day. Hour after hour, it feels free.
lines.visual: SCENE 4: Benny in hoodie on a couch with a plain controller silhouette and snacks. Wall clock ticks; coin pile under his feet stays empty/shrinks. Badge 'ALL DAY' then 'HOUR AFTER HOUR'. On 'free' Benny grins, unaware, while an empty pay envelope flaps open behind him.

lines.text: No pay that day. At typical pay, that is $247.
lines.say: No pay that day. At typical pay, that is two hundred forty-seven dollars.
lines.visual: SCENE 5: Pay stub slaps onto Benny's face, counter drops to -$247. Badge 'AT TYPICAL PAY'. His grin freezes.

lines.text: More than three whole games. For one day.
lines.visual: SCENE 6: Three plain gray generic boxes (no art, no logo), each tagged 'GAME', drop one by one onto frozen Benny and bury him (thud sfx). Headline '3+ GAMES'. Snap-zoom on 'three'. Hold one beat on the pile before the next line.

lines.text: Play after work. That one is really free.
lines.visual: SCENE 7: Boxes vanish. Benny at night in hoodie, happy, tie back on a hook. Badge 'REALLY FREE'.

lines.text: Sick day, or play after work? Comment A or B.
lines.visual: SCENE 8 (on 'Sick day'): Benny coughing with row 'A: SICK DAY'. SCENE 9 (on 'play after work'): Benny smug at night with row 'B: PLAY AFTER WORK'. Benny points at viewer on 'Comment'.
lines.on_screen: A: SICK DAY / B: PLAY AFTER WORK

facts_used.claim: US median usual weekly earnings of full-time workers Q1 2026 = $1,235; full time = 35+ h/week (40 h used as an example).
GTA 6 Standard Edition price $79.99; release Nov 19, 2026.
'GTA Flu' = launch-week meme of faking sick days (no stats used).

upload.title: Is a fake sick day for GTA 6 really free? #Shorts
upload.description:
One day off can cost more than the game itself.
Sick day, or play after work? Comment A or B.
If the day is unpaid, the typical US full-time worker (40 hours a week) loses $247. A new game costs $79.99, so $247 is more than three games.
Not financial advice. Many jobs offer paid sick leave. Pay data: US Bureau of Labor Statistics (median weekly earnings).

changes_from_previous: v4 fixes the owner's three post-approval problems. (1) 'The voice said two hundred fifty dollars and the caption said $250, but the counter on screen landed on -$247': line 4 now says 'two hundred forty-seven dollars', caption '$247', counter -$247. (2) 'The caption read GTA 6 while the voice spelled G, T, A, six': line 1 caption is now 'G T A 6' (say unchanged). (3) 'Some UI text (badges, stamps, headlines) did not match what was being said': every on-screen item re-audited; HOUR 3 -> ALL DAY / HOUR AFTER HOUR, 'TYPICAL PAY - IF UNPAID' -> 'AT TYPICAL PAY' (larger), '3 x $79.99' -> '3+ GAMES' and box tags -> 'GAME', '$0 EXTRA' -> 'REALLY FREE', A/B rows now use the spoken words, unspoken PAY jars and COUGH bubble removed/reworded. Description updated so every number is $247.
